question: Show Apple's Services net sales and Services gross margin percentage for FY2023, FY2024, and FY2025, and the change in Services gross margin over the period.
grading: Net sales ±0.5% (USD millions); GM% exact to 0.1pp; change expressed in pp
answer: Apple Services net sales / Services gross margin were: FY2023, USD 85,200 million / 70.8%; FY2024, USD 96,169 million / 73.9%; FY2025, USD 109,158 million / 75.4%. Services gross margin increased 4.6 percentage points from FY2023 to FY2025. FY2023 had 53 weeks, versus 52 weeks in FY2024 and FY2025. [G20-E1]

**Question:** Show Apple's Services net sales and Services gross margin percentage for FY2023, FY2024, and FY2025, and the change in Services gross margin over the period.
*As of 2026-10-01*

| | Services net sales (USD millions) | Services gross margin percentage (%) |
|---|---|---|
| FY2023 (year ended September 30, 2023) | 85,200 [1] | 70.8 [1] |
| FY2024 (year ended September 28, 2024) | 96,169 [1] | 73.9 [1] |
| FY2025 (year ended September 27, 2025) | 109,158 [1] | 75.4 [1] |

- Apple's Services net sales were $85,200 million in FY2023 (year ended September 30, 2023), $96,169 million in FY2024 (year ended September 28, 2024) and $109,158 million in FY2025 (year ended September 27, 2025), as reported in the FY2025 Form 10-K. [1]
- Apple's Services gross margin percentage was 70.8% in FY2023, 73.9% in FY2024 and 75.4% in FY2025, as reported in the FY2025 Form 10-K. [1]
- The change in Apple's Services gross margin percentage over the period from FY2023 to FY2025 was 4.6 percentage points. [1]
- The year-over-year change in Apple's Services gross margin percentage was 3.1 percentage points from FY2023 to FY2024. [1]
- The year-over-year change in Apple's Services gross margin percentage was 1.5 percentage points from FY2024 to FY2025. [1]
- Apple's Services gross margin dollars were $60,345 million in FY2023, $71,050 million in FY2024 and $82,314 million in FY2025, and the company attributed the FY2025 increase primarily to higher Services net sales and a different mix of services. [1]
